_comment: INTERMEZZO — the doorframe between demi_demi and theGodInUrhead. The album-language line that used to close demi_demi, given a room of its own so it stops stepping on the music. A D-minor gauze (theGodInUrhead's ward timbre) rises out of the record's groove-silence, the deadpan line speaks alone over it, then the gauze resolves onto theGod's opening chord [d3,f3,a3] and fades — the next room is already tuning up. One voice line, sized to its clip (reused from demi_demi, no re-render).

sections.label: the doorframe — the rave's gauze, still hanging in the air
he's wrong of course — tough times ever last and no people ever do
toward the ward — the gauze settles onto D minor, the goddess is next
